title: To Video Display
text: Display images or video frames, 7 inputs, {Window size} sets Display window size; {Open at Start of Simulation} sets the open window at start of simulation, {Input Color Format} and {Image signal} sets the configure input port One multidimensional. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color component of image matrix | array

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color component of image matrix | array

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue color component of image matrix | array

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Luma component of image matrix | array

ports.name: Cb
ports.summary: Blue-difference chroma component of image matrix | array

ports.name: Cr
ports.summary: Red-difference chroma component of image matrix | array

params.name: Window size
params.values: Display window size Normal (default) | Full-screen (Esc to exit) | True size (1:1)

params.name: Open at Start of Simulation
params.values: Open window at start of simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Configure input port One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals
